name: rsvp_event
description:
Accept, decline, or tentatively accept an Outlook Calendar event invitation.

Parameters:
- event_id: The event ID to RSVP to (required, from outlook_calendar_search).
- response_status: One of "accepted", "declined", or "tentative" (required).
- comment: Optional message to include with the response.

event_id.description: The event ID to respond to (from outlook_calendar_search).

comment.description: Optional message to include with the RSVP response.
